第十九章 狐吞火莲烈火焚万鬼（第1页）
幽暗峡谷之中，阴风依旧呼啸，漫天厉鬼依旧盘旋，可那个卑微求生的少女，已然彻底消散。
小白狐纵身掠过层层鬼影，身姿迅捷无比，无视周遭侵蚀神魂的阴煞之气，稳稳落在寒潭中央的莲台之上。潭心幽冥火莲灼灼燃烧，至阳莲火与潭底极阴寒气交织，异象惊人，精纯霸道的火属性灵气四散开来。
小雪没有丝毫迟疑，张口一口，将整株幽冥火莲尽数吞入腹中。
下一瞬，震耳欲聋的火焰轰鸣骤然炸开！
极致狂暴、至纯至阳的赤炎之火从小雪体内轰然爆发，冲天火光瞬间照亮整片昏暗幽暗的黑风峡谷。刺眼烈火席卷四方，将漫天黑雾、阴冷阴风瞬间焚烧殆尽，谷内压抑死寂的氛围一扫而空。
小白狐通体雪白毛发被烈火彻底浸染，尽数化作鲜亮炽烈的火红色，狐尾生长至三尾，尾尖萦绕永不熄灭的明火，狐瞳化作赤红熔岩之色，周身流淌着纯净无比的火之血脉。
历经幽冥火莲重塑血脉，它彻底褪去凡狐之躯，蜕变为天生克制世间一切阴邪鬼物的赤炎灵狐。
小雪仰头发出一声清亮凌厉的狐啸，啸声穿透整片峡谷，带着怒火与悲意。四蹄蹬地，周身赤炎火海席卷而出，径直冲入漫天鬼群之中。
但凡火焰触碰之处，凄厉无比的鬼嚎此起彼伏，所有低阶厉鬼瞬间被烈火焚烧殆尽，直接魂飞魄散，再也无法借助煞气重生。先前无解的鬼潮，在赤炎明火面前，毫无抵抗之力。
鬼首见状凶性大发，舍弃陈默，直奔赤炎火狐扑杀而来。漆黑鬼爪带着极致阴气，想要压制至阳烈火。
可蜕变之后的小雪力量暴涨数倍，身形灵巧躲闪，张口喷出一道粗壮火柱，正面撞上鬼首。
阴阳之力剧烈碰撞，轰鸣声震撼峡谷。
鬼首发出一声绝望哀嚎，周身阴气飞速消融，漆黑身躯被烈火层层吞噬，于是他便狠狠的咒骂道:“畜生！你，你竟敢攻击本尊！啊啊啊，啊……你们都给我去死。”然后他的鬼魂突然的凝缩成了一一颗珠子。看起来翠绿异常，其中的阴寒之气甚至可以从眼球直入脑髓。火狐见状，一踏步来到珠子前。此时这颗鬼珠已经凝聚到了极点感觉其中蕴含的力量可以摧毁一切。但是火狐一掌拍下。烈焰随风盖下不过片刻，便彻底焚烧干净，消散于天地之间。
半柱香过后，谷内所有厉鬼尽数被清缴一空。
阴风停歇，黑雾散尽，阴冷煞气彻底消散，峡谷重归安静，只剩下空气中残留的温热火灵气。
小雪收敛周身明火，火红皮毛柔顺光亮，快步走到陈默脚边，轻轻蹭着他的裤腿，试图安抚他低落的情绪。
陈默低头看着脚下灵狐，又看向少女消散的位置，心底一片荒芜。

纵然焚尽万鬼，纵然获得机缘，可逝去之人，永远不会回来。
乱世无情，仙途残酷，底层之人的挣扎与牺牲，从来都无人铭记。

Chapter 19 The fox swallows the fire lotus and the fierce fire burns all ghosts (page 1)
In the dark canyon, the dark wind is still howling, and the ghosts are still circling in the sky, but the girl who is humblely trying to survive has completely disappeared.
The little white fox flew past the layers of ghosts with extremely swift movements, ignoring the evil spirit that eroded the soul around him, and landed steadily on the lotus platform in the center of the cold pool. The Netherworld Fire Lotus in the center of the pool burned brightly, and the Zhiyang Lotus Fire intertwined with the extremely cold air at the bottom of the pool. The phenomenon was astonishing, and pure and domineering fire-attribute spiritual energy spread out.
Xiaoxue didn't hesitate at all, opened her mouth and swallowed the entire Netherworld Fire Lotus into her belly.
The next moment, the deafening roar of flames suddenly exploded!
The extremely violent and pure red flame burst out from Xiaoxue's body, and the sky-high flame instantly illuminated the entire dark and dark Black Wind Canyon. Dazzling fire swept across all directions, instantly burning away the dark fog and cold wind in the sky, and swept away the oppressive and lifeless atmosphere in the valley.
The snow-white hair on the little white fox's body was completely soaked by the fire, turning it into a bright and fiery red. The fox's tail grew to three tails, with an eternal flame lingering at the tip of the tail. The fox's pupils turned into the color of red lava, and the pure blood of fire flowed all over its body.
After the Netherworld Fire Lotus reshaped its bloodline, it completely lost its mortal fox body and transformed into a red flame spirit fox that was born to restrain all the evil spirits in the world.
Xiaoxue raised her head and let out a clear and sharp fox whistle. The whistle penetrated the entire canyon, carrying anger and sadness. With four hooves kicking on the ground, a sea of ​​red flames swept out of his body, rushing straight into the crowd of ghosts in the sky.
Wherever the flames touched, shrill ghost howls erupted one after another. All the low-level ghosts were instantly burned to death by the fire, and their souls were immediately dispersed. They could no longer be reborn with the help of evil energy. The previously unsolvable ghost tide was helpless in the face of the red flame.
When the ghost leader saw this, he became furious. He abandoned Chen Mo and went straight to the Red Flame Fire Fox to kill him. The dark ghost claws are filled with extreme Yin energy and want to suppress the Yang fire.
But after the transformation, Xiaoxue's strength surged several times, and she dodged nimbly. She opened her mouth to spit out a thick pillar of fire, and hit the ghost head head on.
The power of yin and yang collided violently, and the roar shook the canyon.
The ghost leader let out a desperate cry, and the yin energy around his body melted rapidly, and his dark body was swallowed up by layers of fire, so he cursed fiercely: "Beast! You, how dare you attack me! Ah, ah, ah... you all die." Then his ghost suddenly condensed into beads. It looks extremely green, and the cold air in it can even penetrate from the eyeballs into the brain. Seeing this, the fire fox took one step and came to the bead. At this time, this ghost bead has been condensed to the extreme, and it feels like the power contained in it can destroy everything. But Firefox slapped it down. The flames were covered by the wind for only a moment before they were completely burned and dissipated between heaven and earth.
After half a stick of incense, all the evil ghosts in the valley were cleared away.
The cold wind stopped, the black fog dissipated, the cold evil spirit completely dissipated, and the canyon returned to silence, leaving only the warm fire spirit remaining in the air.
Xiaoxue suppressed the flames all over her body, her fiery red fur was smooth and shiny, and walked quickly to Chen Mo's feet, gently rubbing his trouser legs, trying to soothe his low mood.
Chen Mo looked down at the spirit fox at his feet, and then at the place where the girl disappeared, feeling desolate in his heart.
Even if all ghosts are burned, even if opportunities are given, the people who have passed away will never come back.
Troubled times are ruthless, the path to immortality is cruel, and the struggles and sacrifices of those at the bottom are never remembered.
